name: ScamRead cyber news feed
note: Headlines and summaries are written by AI (Claude) from the original reports. Follow the source links for the full articles.

items.headline: Broadcom Patches 23 VMware Flaws, Two Critical ESX Code Execution Bugs
items.summary: Broadcom disclosed 23 VMware vulnerabilities across vCenter, ESX and other products, including two critical flaws that could let attackers run code on ESX hosts. Administrators should check their versions, and no active exploitation is reported.

items.headline: Okta Links ShinyHunters-Linked Vishing Crew to New INCEPTION Leak Site
items.summary: Okta says a cluster once tied to the ShinyHunters extortion crew appears to have rebranded as INCEPTION, using voice phishing to steal credentials and approvals. Targets span many industries.

items.headline: Hackers Compromise 22 Organizations Via Check Point Security Servers
items.summary: Attackers exploited several vulnerabilities to breach two dozen Check Point security management servers in an ongoing campaign against 22 organizations.

items.headline: Hackers Keep Running EvilTokens Phishing After Microsoft Takedown
items.summary: Attackers are still using the EvilTokens phishing kit to take over Microsoft 365 accounts despite Microsoft shutting the service down. New phishing hosts kept appearing in October and November after two arrests in London.

items.headline: CISA Adds Four Exploited Flaws in VMware, SAP, Cisco and Apache Products
items.summary: CISA added four vulnerabilities affecting VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, and Apache Roller to its exploited catalog. Federal agencies were given until November 23 to patch them.
